info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Fitness Memberships Checkin-v3-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the check-in process for fitness memberships, allowing gyms and fitness centers to manage member attendance efficiently. By utilizing this endpoint, operators can record member check-ins in bulk, ensuring accurate tracking of gym usage and improving operational efficiency. Typical consumers include gym administrators and fitness center software integrations, enabling seamless attendance monitoring and reporting. Enhance your customer experience with effective membership management through the Fitness Membership Check-in Management API.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to check in their memberships. It validates the membership details and updates the check-in status accordingly.
